t.zh: 这一关的 issue 只写了要改哪个文件，代码要从仓库里拿。读文件元件按它的设置读出一个文件，作为一段上下文。
t.en: This level’s issues only say which file to change; the code has to come from the repository. The read part reads the file its setting names, as a context.

after.zh: 你替模型去仓库里拿了它要看的东西。哪个文件该读，现在是你在 issue 里找出来的。
after.en: You fetched from the repository what the model needed to see. Which file to read, you found in the issue yourself.

brief.zh: 没有人替你贴代码了。从仓库里读出要改的文件，交给模型。
brief.en: Nobody pastes the code for you now. Read the file to change from the repository and hand it to the model.
